verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance's Scribe Agent joins incident calls, transcribes in real time, and records key decisions, action items, and events. Advance also uses generative AI to summarize key incident information, and those transcripts feed AI-generated incident summaries and post-incident reviews. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI drafts stakeholder or status updates during the incident, detail on how live summaries refresh as the incident evolves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
